descriptions.zh: 启动后，会自动部署沙箱模板对应的MCP服务函数，MCP服务保证mcp-session-id和SandboxID的唯一映射。MCP client执行工具调用时，MCP服务会自动创建Sandbox
descriptions.en: After activation, the platform automatically deploys the `MCP service` `function` for the specified `sandbox` `template`. The `MCP service` ensures a unique mapping between an `mcp-session-id` and a `SandboxID`. When an MCP `client` invokes a `tool`, the `MCP service` automatically creates a `sandbox`.
